text:
Tara (PMM): quick thread 24h sprint to finalize webinar copy + field battlecard. Focus: benchmark narrative vs cloud-managed endpoints and infra vendors.
Vik (Growth): need two headline variants for paid vs email. also short social lines (1-2 options).
Omar (Field): reps ask for a 2-sentence opener, 3 one-liner objection handlers, and clear CTA to request the gated benchmark. Keep it tiny.
Jin (Bench): top-level bench bullets I can share publicly (gated deck has details):
- p95 latency: ~130ms at sustained 1k RPS in our harness
- token efficiency: batching + KV caching -> ~3x cost reduction on multi-turn chat patterns
- availability: fallback policy maintained throughput during node eviction test
Lila (Content): convert to public-safe phrasing: "customer-observed p95 ~130ms under sustained load" + "measured token savings up to 3x". internal battlecard can include exact numbers.
Pri (Sales Ops): routing rule idea: if lead.company_size > 500 OR lead.behavior includes "benchmark_click" => AE; else SDR. also add tag: "bench_warm".
Tara (PMM): shortlist hooks:
A) "How engineered serving saves you tokens and stabilizes latency"
B) "Why managed endpoints alone don't guarantee production-grade SLAs"
Vik (Growth): run A in paid ads, B in nurture emails. social copy: "Stabilize latency. Reduce token spend. See how."
Omar (Field): objection handlers (3) draft:
- Price push: "We typically see a 2-4x token efficiency on chat flows once batching + caching are enabled; ask for the deck."
- Reliability: "We provide routing fallbacks and deterministic capacity so tail latency doesn't spike during incidents."
- Migration: "Same API surface across hosting modes; most prompts port without infra rework."
Lila (Content): I'll make a 1-pager battlecard with 6 quick lines, 3 demo soundbites, and a gated benchmark CTA. Due in 12h.
Jin (Bench): I'll upload a 2-slide summary + appendix with harness notes (due in 10h). Will anonymize customer data.
Pri (Sales Ops): I will implement the SFDC tag + routing and add automation to create AE tasks for bench_warm leads (due in 18h).
Tara (PMM): measurement plan: experiment key "webinar_opener_v5" -> track open variant, click->signup funnel, and benchmark_cta clicks. Vik, please wire analytics.
Vik (Growth): done. create UTM params: utm_campaign=webinar_v5&utm_term=opA/opB. I'll tag ad clicks with opener=A.
webhook-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-assets/marketing/webinar-395500/bench-summary.pdf at 3955009100
Omar (Field): one extra ask  include a one-slide anonymized prompt comparison (redwood vs managed endpoint) to show latency and quality parity. Keep it gated.
Jin (Bench): will add that slide, with synthetic prompt and response time timeline.
Lila (Content): public blog paragraph draft: "In customer-observed runs, Redwood maintained p95 latencies near 130ms under sustained load and realized material token savings through batching and prefix caching. For full harness details and per-model results, request our benchmark deck."
Tara (PMM): decision: Ads=A, Emails=B, Field gets internal numbers + "ask for benchmark deck" CTA. Keep public phrasing conservative.
Pri (Sales Ops): routing SQL snippet for ops: ```UPDATE routing_rules SET route='AE' WHERE company_size > 500 OR behavior LIKE '%benchmark_click%';```
Vik (Growth): also create experiment variant rule in ad platform with key opener=A/B.
Tara (PMM): check-ins every 6h in this thread. move fast. :rocket:
